works.author: tubik
works.comment: B2B 金融科技网站 Factura：深色发票管理界面，主标题“See who owes you, and when they will pay”，Open $61,400.00、Overdue $9,450.00、Paid $118,970.00 三组金额镇场，Expected 列直接标 likely / at risk，顶部还有一句“How much will land by Nov 15?”的提问框；收款工具用“三组金额 + 一列回款预期”把“谁欠钱、什么时候还”一次讲清。
works.comment_en: Factura, a B2B fintech site: a dark invoice dashboard headlines "See who owes you, and when they will pay", anchored by Open $61,400.00, Overdue $9,450.00 and Paid $118,970.00, with an Expected column flagging each invoice likely or at risk and an Ask box reading "How much will land by Nov 15?"; who owes what and when it lands, answered in one screen of three totals and one forecast column.
works.title: B2B Fintech Website Design

works.author: SlabPixel Designer for SlabPixel
works.comment: AI 自主管理系统 Nexora：浅绿白配色的官网立在显示器样机里，主标题“Don't manage your work, command it”，下方是智能体对话式任务面板；管理工具用“一句反常识口号 + 一块对话面板”把“不用管、只管下令”讲得轻巧。
works.comment_en: Nexora, an AI autonomous management system: a pale green-and-white site on a monitor mockup headlines "Don't manage your work, command it", above an agent-style conversational task panel; "stop managing, start commanding" lands lightly with one contrarian headline and one chat panel.
works.title: AI Autonomous Management System Website Home Page - Nexora

works.author: NexUX Product for Nexux Lab
works.comment: AI 网络安全网站：深色页面中央是一张发光的绿色十字网格人脸，主标题“CYBERSECURITY THAT THINKS AHEAD”，右侧 Real Time Containment 78%、Live Coverage 两块实时数据卡片，左下“32K SERVICES NOW”；安全产品用“一张发光人脸 + 两块实时数字”把看不见的防护做成看得见的阵势。
works.comment_en: An AI cybersecurity site: a glowing green cross-grid face anchors a dark page under "CYBERSECURITY THAT THINKS AHEAD", flanked by Real Time Containment at 78% and Live Coverage data cards, with "32K SERVICES NOW" at lower left; invisible protection becomes a visible presence through one luminous face and two live numbers.
works.title: AI Cybersecurity website

works.author: Imran Hossen
works.comment: AI 工作流编辑器 Lumora：深色节点画布上 Prompt、Character、Kinetix Sampler、Voiceover 四类节点连成视频生成管线，左侧 Assets、Avatars、Voices、Models 素材栏，右侧 Live preview 实时出片；AI 视频工具用“节点连线 + 实时预览”把复杂的生成流程收成一张可拖拽的画布。
works.comment_en: Lumora, an AI workflow editor: a dark node canvas links Prompt, Character, Kinetix Sampler and Voiceover nodes into a video-generation pipeline, with Assets, Avatars, Voices and Models on the left rail and a Live preview rendering on the right; a tangled generation flow becomes one draggable canvas of connected nodes and live output.
works.title: Lumora — AI Workflow Editor

works.author: Outcrowd
works.comment: 深色任务管理卡片：玻璃质感卡片叠在蓝色聚光下，“Assigned to me”里“Create detailed wireframes”32%、“Onboarding flow for a new feature”48%，进度条、耗时 12h 35m、2/8 tasks 一应俱全；任务卡片用“一束光 + 两条进度条”让待办清单有了舞台感。
works.comment_en: Dark task-management cards: glassy cards under a blue spotlight hold "Assigned to me" — "Create detailed wireframes" at 32% and "Onboarding flow for a new feature" at 48% — with progress bars, 12h 35m logged and 2/8 tasks done; a to-do list gains stage presence from one beam of light and two progress bars.
works.title: Task Management — Dark UI Cards

works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 摩托车市集 App Onyx Moto：三屏并排展示发现、列表与详情，黄色跑车标价 $24,000，Diavel V4 Ducati 详情页 $32,000 配 Petrol、2024、V12 65° 三组参数与 Start Order；摩托车市集用“三屏并排 + 一辆黄车”把速度感直接摆上台面。
works.comment_en: Onyx Moto, a motorcycle marketplace app: three screens show discovery, listing and detail side by side — a yellow sport bike at $24,000, a Diavel V4 Ducati detail page at $32,000 with Petrol, 2024 and V12 65° specs and a Start Order button; speed is on display at once through three screens and one yellow bike.
works.title: Motorcycle Marketplace Mobile App

works.author: Awe Design Studio
works.comment: 加密钱包与兑换 App：三屏深紫界面，余额 €15,892.45 配绿色走势图，USDC、LINK、Cardano 持仓列表，兑换页 300.50 换 2.456789 SOL、Swap now 收尾；钱包 App 用“三屏递进 + 一抹紫色渐变”把余额、持仓、兑换串成一条顺滑的动线。
works.comment_en: A crypto wallet and exchange app: three dark screens in a purple gradient show a €15,892.45 balance with a green chart, USDC, LINK and Cardano holdings, and a swap of 300.50 for 2.456789 SOL ending in Swap now; balance, holdings and exchange flow as one smooth path across three screens and one purple gradient.
works.title: Cryptocurrency Wallet & Exchange App

works.author: HALO LAB
works.comment: 健康科技产品站 OmniBuds：黄黑撞色页面，主标题“Every heartbeat is a whisper of truth”，“OmniBuds Innovation, Rooted in Science”配耳内点阵耳廓图，下方 2016 时间线与 Body circulation 人体循环图；健康耳机站用“一句心跳文案 + 一张黄黑大色块”把医疗感做得不冰冷。
works.comment_en: OmniBuds, a healthtech product site: a yellow-and-black page headlines "Every heartbeat is a whisper of truth", with "OmniBuds Innovation, Rooted in Science" beside a dotted ear graphic, a 2016 timeline and a Body circulation diagram below; a medical device reads warm, not clinical, through one heartbeat headline and one bold yellow block.
works.title: Website for a Healthtech Product ✦ OmniBuds

works.author: Bayu Aji Sadewa for Korsa
works.comment: 家具电商落地页 Arbora：笔记本样机里“Furnish Your Dream Home”配棕色竖纹沙发大图，Shop now 按钮与面料小样并排；家具电商用“一台笔记本 + 一张沙发”把“梦想中的家”装进一屏。
works.comment_en: Arbora, a furniture e-commerce landing page: inside a laptop mockup, "Furnish Your Dream Home" sits beside a large photo of a ribbed brown sofa, with a Shop now button and fabric swatches; a dream home fits in one screen through one laptop and one sofa.
works.title: Arbora - Furniture E Commerce Landing Page Animation
